science.text:
What it shows
Mercury has no sea level. Heights use a reference sphere with a radius of 2,439.4 km; zero means the surface of that sphere.
Reading the scale
Meters above the reference sphere. Blue is lower and warm colors are higher; values beyond −6,000 or +6,000 m use endpoint colors.
How it was made
USGS matched surface points across MESSENGER images to build its 2016 global elevation model, version 2.
Limits
The source spacing is about 665 m. The height model was filtered, smoothed and interpolated; this globe displays a coarser sample.
Coverage
Gray grid marks missing source data.
